name: join-count-cta
title: Join count CTA
description: A closing ask anchored by a big number: how many people already did it, a stack of faces, and the button.
docs: Pass count, unit, action and, for the full effect, avatars, description, note and asOf. The heading carries the whole figure as text (Join 48,213 teams) in the locale's number format, so the count is the same for everyone and for search. The number is set very large, with a size that follows the width of the band. When the band scrolls into view from below, the number rises once to its value; where it is already on screen when the page loads, or the reader prefers reduced motion, it stands still, so the figure is never wrong and nothing flashes. The faces are decoration and hidden from assistive technology; a face without a picture shows initials. Use only a count you can verify, and pass asOf (an ISO day or a date) so the figure is dated underneath it, written for locale in a time element. labels translates the dating line; lead is the word before the number.
